record.title: Jul 2, 2026·China·ShengquCMS second test opens with unbound gold, face-to-face trading, and 5% feesThe second Chinese Classic test opened on July 2 at 2 PM China time. The big changes fix the economy rules that made players angry in May. Gold is no longer locked to your character. Face-to-face trading is back. The auction house takes regular gold now. Free Market personal shops and hired-merchant shops are back too. The trading fee dropped from 10% to 5%. Shengqu also rolled some maps back to their older look, removed the mini-dungeon system, and restored old details like potion colors and skill effects. The Cash Shop stays closed during the test.Closed TestPatch
